title: Recursive Self-Improving AI Trading Bot

nodes.label: Market Data Ingestion
nodes.description: Initiates scheduled pulls of market prices and account state from the provider, normalizes results, and stores raw observations durably for features and audit.

nodes.label: Feature Store
nodes.description: Stores versioned features and curated market datasets with provenance, scoped by version for training, backtesting, and inference reuse.

nodes.label: Strategy Model Service
nodes.description: Produces typed trade proposals (instrument, side, size, price bounds) from current features using the currently released model and strategy configuration.

nodes.label: Proposal Validator
nodes.description: Deterministically validates every trade and compensation proposal's structure, risk limits, and allowed constraints before any approval or execution.

nodes.label: Policy and Approval
nodes.description: Applies risk policy and records operator or in-policy auto-approval for validated order and compensation actions; rejects are terminal and audited.

nodes.label: Order Execution
nodes.description: Executes only approved orders with a reserved durable operation identity, revalidates authorization and freshness before submission, and reconciles uncertain commits by read-back.

nodes.label: Broker Exchange
nodes.description: External broker and market data provider; authoritative target for order placement and cancellation and source of fills, positions, and market observations.

nodes.label: Portfolio Ledger
nodes.description: Authoritative owner of positions, cash, order lifecycle state, and correlated audit trail of proposals, decisions, executions, and terminal outcomes.

nodes.label: Outcome Feedback Collector
nodes.description: Collects realized trade outcomes and hostile or anomalous traces into curated versioned evidence with provenance for offline evaluation; never mutates live configuration directly.

nodes.label: Offline Evaluation
nodes.description: Runs backtests and evaluation of candidate strategy or model changes against versioned evidence, producing reviewed metrics and a promotion recommendation.

nodes.label: Release Registry
nodes.description: Owns reviewed immutable model, prompt, and strategy releases; performs canary rollout, and keeps promotion and rollback as distinct recorded controlled operations.

nodes.label: Operations Monitor
nodes.description: Monitors execution health, reconciliation anomalies, and canary metrics; raises bounded escalations for unknown commits and triggers rollback review on regressions.

assumptions: The bot trades a single brokerage/exchange account with real funds; orders are external mutations requiring deterministic validation and human policy approval before execution.
Self-improvement is offline: trade outcomes and market data are curated into versioned evidence, evaluated by backtests, and released as reviewed immutable model/strategy versions behind a canary.
A human operator approves risk policy changes and release promotions; routine in-policy order proposals may be auto-approved by policy.
Market data is pulled from an external provider on a schedule; no continuous unbounded streaming is required.
Compensation (order cancellation or reversal) follows the same proposal, validation, approval, execution, reconciliation, and audit path as normal orders.
Retryable internal writes reserve a durable operation identity and reconcile timeout-after-commit by authoritative read-back.
